verdict.rationale: An API spec is a fair question for a self-hostable email app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows Zero documents no public HTTP API, and its MCP.md is only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema. Nothing indicates a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec; the MCP server is an adjacent feature, not a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
